# Canonical v1.3 import

Place the exact published working v1.3 RBZ or its extracted source here before implementation begins.

Do not place a later experimental build here.

On import, record:

- original filename;
- file size;
- SHA-256 checksum;
- archive manifest;
- date last confirmed working;
- SketchUp and operating-system version used for confirmation.

The binary archive itself is ignored by Git so it cannot be casually modified and recommitted as though it were the baseline.
